summary: Klarna Group plc filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, announcing the submission of applications to establish Klarna Bank USA, a Utah-chartered industrial bank, to the Utah Department of Financial Institutions and the FDIC. This is a regulatory application for a banking charter, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring. The filing does not involve any transaction terms, premiums, or deal mechanics. It is a routine report of a regulatory step. There is no special-situation event; the filing is a standard current report of corporate development.
